exposure: conservative surgical management of early postpartum hemorrhage (PPH)
outcome: Success rate of conservative surgical management for early postpartum hemorrhage
cohort: 92 patients out of 39,327 deliveries who had early postpartum hemorrhage and received conservative surgical management
finding: Maternal age < 35 years, blood loss before conservative management < 1800 mL, and time to conservative surgery ≤ 40 min were predictive factors of successful conservative surgical management for early PPH.
mod_finding: This study on conservative surgical management of early postpartum hemorrhage did not examine specific mode of delivery as a factor but noted that the majority of patients (92.4%) underwent cesarean section.
